jobs.title: Corporate Strategy, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
You will be a key contributor in shaping and directing the execution of Equinix’s enterprise strategy. Partnering closely with the Chief Strategy Officer and the executive team, this individual will focus on the translation of the long-term strategy into a clear, actionable, and measurable multi-year strategic roadmap.

We are looking for an all-star contributor to the Corporate Strategy team with experience in cross-functional strategy formulation and strategic planning at large enterprises. You will work closely with key leaders across all functions within Equinix and support the executive team’s strategy agenda across short and long-term horizons. This will involve identifying and managing key trade-offs in how we define our most promising growth levers at an enterprise level, as well as evaluating the corresponding capital allocation decisioning across both organic and inorganic avenues.

This role works at the core of Equinix as part of the Corporate Strategy team. This is a fast-paced, high-growth team tasked with leading change in the way Equinix maps its company strategy through a critical inflection point in our industry. We are looking for smart, independent, and creative thinkers who are driven team players with a desire to deliver impact across Equinix. Our team is filled with thoughtful problem solvers who enjoy helping each other achieve and develop. We embrace diversity in thought and are committed to providing an equitable work environment.

Responsibilities
Shaping enterprise strategy
- Connect the dots across long and short-term enterprise-wide strategies to drive coherent choices; requires an in-depth understanding of Equinix’s market position and growth levers across multiple time horizons

- Support the Corporate Strategy team and adjacent functions in designing and implementing improvements to the enterprise-level strategic planning process.

- Act as a key thought partner to the CSO and functional leaders, contributing insights on business, technology, and operational strategy

- Work collaboratively across functions and regions to prioritize and manage a portfolio of critical strategic initiatives on an on-going basis

Managing strategic decisioning
- Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives, providing thought leadership and constructive challenge to optimize business initiatives

- Oversee financial and business performance analysis, ensuring data-driven decision-making and setting of clear KPIs

- Work closely with other central corporate functions to establish and manage efficient communications and discussions with the executive team on critical strategy topics

Defining the enterprise operating plan
- Collaborate with central functions to build, maintain, and leverage financial models to make key strategic decisions and integrate implications into long-term forecasts

- Synthesize long-term market forces and short-term strategic decisions to continuously evaluate growth drivers

- Monitor execution performance against strategic decisions and assumptions to diagnose potential challenges and recommend course corrections

Supporting capital allocation and strategic ventures
- Partner with enterprise leadership to help guide Equinix's capital deployment in support of the enterprise operating plan of record; requires close coordination across strategy, finance, and investment stakeholders

- Support the development of pipeline strategy and capital allocation frameworks that inform where and how Equinix invests across its portfolio

- Bring an enterprise strategy lens to key investment trade-offs, ensuring capital deployment decisions remain aligned with long-term growth priorities and return expectations

- Support the identification, evaluation, and development of strategic venture opportunities that extend Equinix's growth beyond organic levers, contributing to the strategic and financial thesis underpinning new venture opportunities in close partnership with Corporate Development and other functional leaders

Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree or higher from an accredited institution

- 7+ years’ professional experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, or private equity. Technology industry experience preferred but not required

- Experience in driving work within an enterprise-level strategic planning process

- Repeated experience building complex financial models, forecasting corporate performance and decision implications across multi-year horizons at large enterprises (e.g., Fortune 500, Forbes Global 2000). Preference for experience with capex intensive industries

- Proven track-record in framing and leading project management of cross-functional strategy initiatives

- Demonstrated ability to assess strategic initiatives, challenge initiative owners constructively, and drive execution feasibility

- Strong influencing skills, including building stakeholder relationships with senior leaders and demonstrated ability to shape strategic direction without direct authority

- Proven track record in providing novel and innovative solutions to complex or difficult strategic issues

- Ability to independently draft and present client deliverables, recommendations, and communications strategies

- Deep analytical, problem-solving, and data-centric decision-making capabilities

- Self-motivated with a demonstrated ability to drive work through ambiguity in a dynamic, results-oriented environment

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
The FX and Rates team plays a key role in supporting Equinix’s rapid international growth. Operating in over 30 countries and generating the majority of our earnings outside the U.S., we face complex foreign currency environments as we expand globally. To enable scalable solutions for cash flow predictability, earnings protection, and equity risk reduction, we actively manage foreign exchange exposure through the use of FX derivatives.
Our growth, combined with the capital-intensive nature of our business and our REIT structure, requires frequent access to debt and equity markets. To mitigate the interest rate risk associated with this ongoing funding activity, we utilize interest rate derivatives.
In this role, you will be a critical part of our treasury team involved in shaping and managing Equinix’s global foreign currency and interest rate hedging strategy, with a particular focus on accounting. You will have opportunities to develop and partner with capital markets, corporate development, FP&A, investor relations, tax, legal, and accounting internally. Externally, your stakeholders would include external legal providers, investment banks, auditors, and consultants. The ideal candidate brings expertise in derivative hedge accounting within a multinational environment and experience in or a passion for financial markets.

Responsibilities
- Identify foreign exchange and interest rate exposures, use derivatives and other hedging strategies to manage exposures, and support the accounting and reporting of the hedging programs

- Negotiate terms and execute trades with banking counterparts

- Maintain and manage the trade repository, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and proper classification of all derivative transactions

- Perform month-end close activities including valuation of derivative instruments, preparation of journal entries, and GL account reconciliations

- Lead the preparation and review of 10-Q and 10-K sections related to the company’s hedging programs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and appropriate detail in communicating their impact on financial performance

- Collaborate with IT on various data integration and automation projects, propose and design streamlined processes, look for continuous improvement opportunities

- Serve as a key partner to Accounting, SEC Reporting, and both internal and external audit teams to ensure compliance with US GAAP, adherence to SOX controls, and timely fulfillment of audit requests

Qualifications
- Demonstrated history of identifying, proposing, and implementing process improvements across financial reporting and close processes required

- Demonstrated history of problem-solving skills and a tendency to take initiative.

- Knowledge of U.S. GAAP required

- Public accounting experience a plus

- Experience in Reval, Oracle Cloud, and Hyperion preferred

- Highly collaborative temperament with superb attention to detail and proven communication skills

- A strong interest in finance is required to effectively understand the economics of derivatives transactions and associated accounting practices

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related discipline. A Master’s degree is a   plus

- 3+ years of experience in derivative accounting or a related field

- Experience in large-scale, global, or high-growth organizations, ideally including business partnering, corporate strategy, and global leadership exposure

- Demonstrates strategic thinking, a growth mindset, and sound business judgment
